description: Compact copy of battery-degradation-sim results (grid*.json, traces*.json) for the blog explorer. PyBaMM DFN + O'Kane 2022 coupled degradation, OKane2022 / LG M50 parameters. Capacity = 1C discharge capacity in % of cycle 1 (thinned). loss_Ah = inventory at ref_cycle (EOL if reached, else last simulated cycle): sei, sei_cracks, plating = lithium lost; lam_ne, lam_pe = electrode capacity lost; not additive into measured_loss_Ah. bd = the same inventory thinned over cycles; life = lowest anode potential and peak cell temperature per saved cycle; traces = within-charge anode potential at the saved cycles. phi = negative-electrode potential at the separator during charge, mV vs Li/Li+.
